name: linear
description: Linear integration — search, read, create, and update issues, list teams, and add comments via the Linear GraphQL API.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Linear issue tracking and project management

fields.label: Personal API Key
fields.helpText: Create a personal API key in Linear settings

tools.name: linear.search_issues
tools.description: Search issues by text query, returning identifier, title, state, assignee, and URL.

query.description: Free-text search across issue titles and descriptions

tools.name: linear.get_issue
tools.description: Get a single issue by UUID or identifier (e.g. ENG-123).

id.description: Issue UUID or identifier such as ENG-123

tools.name: linear.list_teams
tools.description: List all teams with their id, name, and key.

tools.name: linear.create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a team.

teamId.description: UUID of the team to create the issue in

priority.description: Priority: 0 none, 1 urgent, 2 high, 3 normal, 4 low

assigneeId.description: UUID of the user to assign

tools.name: linear.update_issue
tools.description: Update fields on an existing issue.

id.description: Issue UUID or identifier such as ENG-123

stateId.description: UUID of the workflow state to move the issue to

priority.description: Priority: 0 none, 1 urgent, 2 high, 3 normal, 4 low

assigneeId.description: UUID of the user to assign

tools.name: linear.add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an issue.

issueId.description: Issue UUID or identifier such as ENG-123
